app.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
app.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
app.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
app.notFoundBody: The link may be outdated, or the page may have moved.
app.loginSubtitle: We will email you a one-time code.
app.loginCodeSubtitle: We sent an 8-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
app.loginResendIn: You can request a new code in {seconds} s
app.loginInvalidCode: That code is not valid. Check it and request a new one if needed.
app.loginMfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
app.loginMfaRecoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication.
app.callbackMissingFlow: This sign-in link is no longer valid. Start again from the sign-in page.
app.securityTotpBody: Protect publishing and administrative actions with a code from an authenticator app.
app.securityTotpScan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
app.securityTotpManual: Cannot scan? Enter this secret manually.
app.securityRecoveryBody: Each code works once and lets you sign in without your authenticator. This is the only time they are shown.
app.securityDisableBody: Your account will be protected by the email code alone, and publishing tokens will need a fresh sign-in instead of a code.
app.stepUpBody: This action needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
app.stepUpNoFactor: This account has no authenticator app. Sign in again to continue.
app.sessionsSubtitle: Browsers and devices signed in to this account.
app.tokensSubtitle: Credentials for the dart pub client and CI. They are separate from your browser session.
app.tokensEmptyBody: Create a token to publish packages or to let CI read your private registry.
app.tokensStepUpNotice: Publishing and administrative scopes ask for a second-factor code before the token is issued.
app.tokensOrgRequired: Choose an organization for this token.
app.tokensSecretBody: This is the only time the secret is shown. Store it somewhere safe.
app.tokensSecretCli: Register it with the pub client:
app.tokensRevokeBody: Anything using {name} stops working within a minute. This cannot be undone.
app.orgsSubtitle: Each organization owns its packages, members, and registry URL.
app.orgsEmpty: You are not in any organization yet
app.orgsEmptyBody: Create one to publish private packages and invite your team.
app.orgsSlugHint: Becomes the registry address and can never be changed.
app.orgsSlugRequired: Enter a slug of lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
app.orgsAcceptInviteBody: Paste the invitation code from the email an administrator sent you.
app.orgsInviteCodeInvalid: That invitation code is not valid. It may have expired or already been used.
app.homeTaglineFallback: A self-hosted package registry for Dart and Flutter.
app.homeCountersScoped: Counters cover what you can see — signing in to more organizations shows more.
app.searchSubtitle: Full-text search over package names, descriptions, and readmes, with filter tags.
app.searchIgnoredFilters: These filters were not understood and were ignored: {filters}
app.searchEmptyBody: Try fewer filters, or check the search syntax help.
app.searchEmptyBrowse: This instance has no packages you can see yet.
app.searchFailed: The search could not be completed.
app.searchSyntaxIntro: Combine free text with filter tags. Unknown tags are ignored and listed above the results.
app.searchSyntaxOrg: Only packages owned by that organization.
app.searchSyntaxTopic: Only packages declaring that topic in their pubspec.
app.searchSyntaxDependency: Only packages that depend on that package.
app.searchSyntaxFormat: Artifact format; only pub exists today.
app.searchSyntaxSort: Ordering inside the query; overrides the control.
app.searchSyntaxNegate: A leading minus excludes matches of that filter.
app.searchSyntaxPhrase: Quotes match the words next to each other.
app.pkgVersionsTruncated: Only the most recent versions are listed; the pub client sees all of them.
app.pkgDependentsEmptyBody: Dependents appear once another package on this instance declares it in its pubspec.
app.pkgNoReadme: This version shipped without a README
app.pkgNoChangelog: This version shipped without a CHANGELOG
app.pkgDiscontinuedBody: The maintainers marked this package as no longer maintained.
app.pkgLatestRetractedBody: The newest published version is retracted, so the version above is an older one that resolution still picks.
app.pkgUnlistedBody: This package is hidden from search and listings. It still resolves by name.
app.pkgVersionRetractedBody: This version is excluded from new resolutions. Existing lockfiles keep working.
app.pkgInstallPubspecBody: The hosted URL is part of the snippet on purpose — without it the dependency resolves against pub.dev on any machine that has no PUB_HOSTED_URL set.
app.pkgInstallHostedBody: This is the PUB_HOSTED_URL for the owning organization.
app.pkgInstallTokenBody: This package is private, so the pub client needs a token for this registry base.
app.manageIntro: These controls change what the registry serves. Retraction and deletion are audited.
app.manageOptionsBody: Visibility and discovery flags. All of them are reversible.
app.manageUnlistedHint: Hidden from search, facets, counters, and organization listings — still resolvable by name.
app.manageDiscontinuedHint: The pub client warns about it; existing versions stay downloadable.
app.manageReplacedByHint: Only meaningful while discontinued. Leave empty to clear it.
app.manageRetractBody: A retracted version stays downloadable but is excluded from new resolutions.
app.manageRetractWindow: Retraction can be undone only for a limited window after it happens; afterwards the only way forward is publishing a new version.
app.manageDeleteBody: Removes the archive bytes. The version number stays burned forever and can never be republished.
app.manageDeleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Prefer retraction unless the bytes themselves must go.
app.manageDeleteConfirmLabel: Type the package and version to confirm
app.manageTransferBody: Moves the package to another organization you own. Its registry base changes with it.
app.manageTransferWarning: Existing dependencies keep resolving, but the hosted URL your team pastes changes.
app.manageTransferConfirmLabel: Type the package name to confirm
app.manageTransferNoTargets: You own no other organization that could receive this package.
app.orgRegistryHint: Point the pub client at this base to publish and consume this organization's packages.
app.orgPackagesEmptyBody: Private packages appear here once you are a member of this organization.
app.orgPackagesTruncated: Only the newest packages are listed. Use search to see the rest.
app.orgManageForbidden: Managing this organization needs the Admin role.
app.orgManageSlugLocked: The slug is the registry base and cannot change — renaming it would break every configured PUB_HOSTED_URL.
app.orgManageUpstreamHint: Blocking stops this organization's registry base from falling through to the upstream registry.
app.orgUpstreamAllow: Allow — fall through to the upstream registry
app.orgMemberStepUpNotice: Granting Write or above asks for your second factor again, and a demotion signs the member out everywhere.
app.orgMemberRemoveBody: {name} loses access to this organization's packages and is signed out of it.
app.orgInviteTokenBody: Shown once. It is also emailed — copy it if this instance has no SMTP configured.
app.notifSubtitle: Publishes, membership changes, and security alarms from your organizations.
app.notifEmptyBody: Activity in your organizations shows up here.
app.notifStreamReconnecting: Live updates are reconnecting. The list below is still correct; it just will not update on its own right now.
app.notifPrefsSubtitle: Choose where each category is delivered. Three categories, not one switch per event type.
app.notifPrefsPackageHint: Publishes and retractions in your organizations. Not emailed by default — a publish firehose in an inbox gets the sender filtered.
app.notifPrefsOrgHint: Membership and invitation changes. High importance, emailed by default.
app.notifPrefsSecurityHint: Shadowing alarms and upstream integrity events. Only organization Admins and Owners receive them.
app.eventShadowing: Upstream now publishes a package with a name claimed here: {name}
app.eventQuarantine: An upstream archive failed its checksum and was refused: {name}
app.eventStreamCapped: Too many live connections for this account — live updates are off in this tab.
app.adminSubtitle: Runtime settings, accounts, organizations, the audit log, and background jobs.
app.adminSettingsInvalid: Some fields need fixing before this can be saved.
app.adminFieldPositive: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
app.adminFieldDomain: Each line must be a domain, without an @ and with at least one dot.
app.adminBrandingBody: How this instance names itself. Changes take effect on the next request, not the next restart.
app.adminBrandingColorHint: Stored and reported, but not applied to the interface — the theme's colour pairs are contrast-checked at build time and a custom value would bypass that gate.
app.adminRegistrationBody: Who may create an account on this instance.
app.adminAllowedDomainsHint: One per line. Empty allows every domain — a typo here is a lockout, not a filter.
app.adminLimitsBody: Every value must be at least 1 — a zero would lock this instance out of its own sign-in.
app.adminLimitOtpEmail: Sign-in codes per email, per hour
app.adminLimitOtpIp: Sign-in codes per IP, per hour
app.adminLimitLoginIp: Credential attempts per IP, per minute
app.adminLimitTokenFail: Failed token authentications per IP, per minute
app.adminSmtpBody: Used for sign-in codes, invitations, and high-importance notifications.
app.adminSmtpHostHint: Empty disables runtime SMTP; the instance then falls back to its boot configuration.
app.adminSmtpPasswordHint: Never returned by the API. Leave the field empty to clear the stored password instead of replacing it.
app.adminUpstreamBody: Whether unclaimed names may resolve through the upstream registry, and what new organizations start with.
app.adminUserSuspended: Account suspended; its sessions were revoked.
app.adminAuditActionHint: Matched as a prefix, so org.member. covers every membership action.
app.adminShadowingBody: An upstream registry publishes these names too. Local packages always win resolution, so nothing broke — but somebody may be squatting a name your organization uses.
app.adminQuarantineBody: The bytes upstream served did not match the checksum it advertised, so they were refused rather than cached.
app.adminJobsIntro: Jobs run on a schedule behind a cluster-wide lock. Triggering one here runs it now, on this instance, under the same lock.
app.adminJobsNone: This instance runs no jobs on demand
app.resourceNotFoundBody: This name does not exist here, or it is not visible to you. Signing in to the owning organization may show it.
app.resourceForbiddenBody: This screen needs a higher role than you have here. Ask an administrator of this organization or instance if you need it.
